title: Performance of a deep-learning algorithm for referable thoracic abnormalities on chest radiographs: A multicenter study of a health screening cohort
summary: A commercial deep-learning radiograph algorithm was evaluated against CT-ground-truth in a multicenter health-screening cohort, with clinically specific sensitivity/specificity results.
ai_technology: A commercial deep-learning model detects referable thoracic abnormalities in chest radiographs.
organization: Department of Radiology, Gil Medical Center, Gachon University College of Medicine, Incheon, South Korea.

evidence.tested: retrospective multicenter cohort of 5,887; CT-based reference and radiologist comparisons; AUC 0.771, sensitivity 69.6%, specificity 74.0% for referable abnormalities. Performance is moderate and screening impact was not tested.
